🎬 Lucky (2017)

Lucky follows a 90-year-old atheist living alone in a quiet desert town, where he spends his days following familiar routines, visiting local diners, and spending time with eccentric friends. Despite his independent lifestyle and sharp personality, Lucky begins questioning his beliefs after an unexpected health scare forces him to confront his own mortality. As he reflects on aging, loneliness, friendship, and the meaning of existence, ordinary conversations gradually reveal deeper truths about life. Combining gentle humor, emotional storytelling, and thoughtful moments, the film explores mortality, acceptance, human connection, and finding peace with life’s uncertainties.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 28m • Not Rated

🎥 Director: John Carroll Lynch

🏆 Recognition: Starring Harry Dean Stanton in one of his final film roles, alongside David Lynch, the film received critical acclaim for its heartfelt storytelling and powerful lead performance.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Fandango at Home for current streaming, rental, or purchase availability. Availability varies by region.
